title: EEG and autonomic responses during emotional word association
description: This dataset comprises synchronized electroencephalographic (EEG), autonomic physiological, and behavioral recordings acquired during an emotional word association task. Participants performed a lexical task involving emotionally relevant concepts associated with fear, selecting or generating words in response to prompts while neural activity and autonomic responses were recorded. The dataset includes 8-channel EEG data, electrodermal activity, blood volume pulse, interbeat interval, skin temperature measurements, and timestamped behavioral event markers with semantic similarity metrics.
methods_description: EEG signals were acquired using an OpenBCI Cyton board with Ultracortex Mark IV headset (8 channels at Fp1, Fp2, F3, F4, P7, P8, O1, O2; 250 Hz sampling rate). Autonomic physiological signals were recorded using an Empatica E4 wristband, including electrodermal activity, blood volume pulse, interbeat interval, and skin temperature. All data streams were timestamped during acquisition to enable synchronization between EEG, physiological, and behavioral recordings.
